legal.cookies.title: Cookies
legal.cookies.intro: TODO(fluxkit): replace with the shop's own legal text. This shop sets only the cookies listed below, which it needs to keep your cart and your sign-in, and, once you choose one, your theme. It sets no cookie for analytics or advertising and loads no third-party scripts, so it shows no cookie banner.
legal.cookies.row.cart.when: You add the first item to your cart.
legal.cookies.row.cart.kept: For the cart retention period the shop sets (30 days by default).
legal.cookies.row.session.purpose: Keeps you signed in to your account.
legal.cookies.row.session.when: You sign in or create an account.
legal.cookies.row.session.kept: Until you sign out or the sign-in expires.
legal.cookies.row.theme.purpose: Remembers the theme you chose (light, dark or as on your device). Holds no personal data.
legal.cookies.row.theme.when: You choose a theme at the bottom of the page.
legal.cookies.row.theme.kept: One year, or until you choose another theme.
legal.cookies.staff: Staff who sign in to the shop's back office receive one more session cookie of the same kind. Visitors never receive it.
